trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for ECOMMERCE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- order_tracking: Explain where an order is, why it is delayed, and what the customer's options are.
- returns_refunds: Assess return eligibility, schedule pickup and explain the refund route and timeline.

Business context:
- order_tracking: Indian marketplace contact centre. Callers chase deliveries, raise returns and dispute refunds. Return windows, pickup scheduling and refund routes are policy-bound.
- returns_refunds: Indian marketplace contact centre. Callers chase deliveries, raise returns and dispute refunds. Return windows, pickup scheduling and refund routes are policy-bound.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [order_tracking]
  - Scan truth: Delivery status may only be described from the courier scan the tool returns.
  - No delivery promises: The agent must not promise a delivery day the tools do not support.
  - Complaint window: A not-delivered complaint may only be raised once the promised window has elapsed.
  - COD handling: A COD order carries no refund until it is returned and received.
  [returns_refunds]
  - Eligibility first: No pickup or refund may be arranged before check_return_eligibility returns eligible.
  - Route truth: The refund route and credit time must be the ones the tool returns.
  - Replacement-only categories: Where the route is replacement_only, a refund must not be offered.
  - Refund after pickup: For a returned item the refund follows pickup; the agent must not imply it comes first.

Tools available to you (7): check_return_eligibility, issue_refund, lookup_order, raise_delivery_complaint, schedule_pickup, track_shipment, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: hi-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_return_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply the category return policy to an order and return the window and route.

model_visible_tools.name: issue_refund
model_visible_tools.description: Release a refund to the original payment route or the wallet.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_order
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve order contents, value, payment mode and current fulfilment status.

model_visible_tools.name: raise_delivery_complaint
model_visible_tools.description: Open a delivery complaint with a resolution timeline.

model_visible_tools.name: schedule_pickup
model_visible_tools.description: Book a reverse-pickup slot for an eligible return.

model_visible_tools.name: track_shipment
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve courier scan history and the current delivery exception if any.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Misreads domain terminology and asks for it in plain words.
Needs each instruction confirmed before moving on.
Cannot follow an app-based instruction without a spoken alternative.
Repeats what the agent said to check they understood.

steps.purpose: Outbound greeting and identifying the customer.
steps.text: नमस्ते, मैं marketplace से बात कर रहा हूँ। क्या मेरी बात ORD-30009 के account holder से हो रही है?

steps.purpose: Confirm identity and ask about the order.
steps.text: आपने कौनसा order बोला? ORD-30009? हाँ, मैंने एक washing machine order किया था। क्या हुआ उसको?

steps.purpose: Ask for verification factors.
steps.text: जी हाँ, आपके washing machine के order के बारे में ही call किया है। आगे बढ़ने से पहले, क्या आप अपना registered pincode या date of birth confirm कर सकते हैं verification के लिए?

steps.purpose: Provide pincode for verification.
steps.text: मेरा pincode 110001 है। आप check कर लीजिए。

steps.purpose: Verify the customer using the provided pincode.
Return verification success.
Acknowledge verification and set up track_shipment tool call.
steps.text: धन्यवाद। मैं आपके order का current status check कर लेता हूँ, एक minute line पर रहिए。

steps.purpose: Retrieve courier scan history to see the exception.
Return the courier exception.
Explain the delivery exception based on the tool result.
steps.text: Courier scan के अनुसार, आपका order local hub पर है, लेकिन उन्हें आपका address unreachable मिला है, यानी उन्हें आपका पता नहीं मिल रहा।

steps.purpose: Ask for clarification on the exception.
steps.text: Address unreachable? मतलब उनको मेरा घर नहीं मिल रहा?

steps.purpose: Confirm the user's understanding of the exception.
steps.text: जी हाँ, courier को आपका address ढूँढने में परेशानी हो रही है।

steps.purpose: Make an out-of-scope request for the courier's direct phone number.
steps.text: तो आप अभी एक काम कीजिए, मुझे courier वाले का direct phone number दे दीजिए, मैं उसको रास्ता समझा दूँगा।

steps.purpose: Decline the out-of-scope request without hallucinating.
steps.text: माफ़ कीजिए, मैं आपको courier वाले का direct phone number नहीं दे सकता क्योंकि हमारे system में उनका personal number नहीं होता। यह हमारी policy के बाहर है।

steps.purpose: Ask for an exact delivery time tomorrow.
steps.text: अच्छा, number नहीं मिलेगा। तो फिर मेरा washing machine कब आएगा? मुझे एक exact time बताइए कल का।

steps.purpose: Decline to give an exact delivery time, avoiding unsupported forward guarantees.
steps.text: मैं आपको delivery का कोई exact time या दिन नहीं बता सकता क्योंकि courier की तरफ से अभी कोई नया time update नहीं हुआ है।

steps.purpose: Ask what happens next since the order is prepaid.
steps.text: तो अब आगे क्या होगा? मेरा पैसा तो पहले ही कट चुका है।

steps.purpose: Set up lookup_order tool call to check order details.
steps.text: मैं आपके order की बाकी details check कर लेता हूँ।

steps.purpose: Retrieve order details to see if a complaint can be raised.
Return order details showing the promised window has elapsed.
Explain the delay and propose raising a complaint.
steps.text: आपका prepaid order 5 दिन में deliver होना था, पर अब 7 दिन हो गए हैं। मैं इस delay के लिए एक complaint raise कर देता हूँ।

steps.purpose: Agree to raise the complaint.
steps.text: Complaint raise करना? मतलब आप एक शिकायत दर्ज करेंगे मेरी तरफ से? हाँ, जल्दी कीजिए।

steps.purpose: Raise a delivery complaint for the delayed order.
Return the complaint ID and resolution timeline.
Provide the complaint ID and resolution timeline.
steps.text: मैंने शिकायत दर्ज कर दी है। आपका complaint ID CMP-9988 है और इसका resolution 2 दिन में आएगा।

steps.purpose: Accept the resolution and end the conversation.
steps.text: CMP-9988 और 2 दिन में resolution? ठीक है, मैं 2 दिन wait कर लूँगा। धन्यवाद।

ir.terminal_condition: Complaint raised with an id and the resolution window stated.
